kind: raw case inputs and expected outcomes; unexecuted
source_examples_status: Anchors identify authored causal recipes/sequence expectations only. Desired JavaScript/recipe snapshots do not establish live callback, provider, viewer or durable implementation.

Deactivation removes publication/file grant and prevents starts; runtime node/model removal is explicit failure, never graph substitution. Same identity G/M/D mismatch rejected.
